risk.rationale: No surviving verified findings remain for case-005 (e.oz@aegean.edu). Both suspicious signals were rejected with adequate explanation: the OWA forwarding rule targets an internal @aegean.edu archive mailbox (not exfiltration), and the sign-in from 193.140.10.9 follows 71 failures across 68 accounts with 187 distinct MFA completions from the same shared egress IP in 30 days, consistent with background noise rather than a coordinated password spray. There are no data-quality conflicts and no confirmed account takeover chain. All signals are explained away; no exposure or insufficient evidence requires human review.
